recommendation: Keep the source fix and let the normal FHIR publisher regenerate derived artifacts. No additional related issue should be committed from this investigation because the other discovered issues were background, profile/value-set/text changes, unresolved, or no-change decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-26989 is Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked BR&R to make AdministrableProductDefinition.administrableDoseForm optional because some product records have only the dispensed form while still needing licensed routes. A Jira comment on the same issue explicitly extended the same rationale to ManufacturedItemDefinition.manufacturedDoseForm.
initial_application: No prior git commit mentioning FHIR-26989 was found in the AdministrableProductDefinition or ManufacturedItemDefinition source history. Current source already had AdministrableProductDefinition.administrableDoseForm as 0..1, but ManufacturedItemDefinition.manufacturedDoseForm still had min 1.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists both resources as active current-build resources and BR&R-owned. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later final or community evidence reversing the optional-cardinality decision. FHIR-23920 is background about mandatory manufactured item details but resolved through a simpler Ingredient link, not this base cardinality.
reconciliation: Changed source/manufactureditemdefinition/structuredefinition-ManufacturedItemDefinition.xml so ManufacturedItemDefinition.manufacturedDoseForm has min 0 instead of min 1. No narrative or generated diagram change was needed because the authoritative StructureDefinition was the inconsistent source.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue mentioned the burden of mandatory ManufacturedItemDefinition.manufacturedDoseForm, but its resolution used a direct MedicinalProductDefinition.ingredient link for simple cases and did not decide this base cardinality.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive BR&R issue asked for AdministrableProductDefinition.administrableDoseForm to be optional and commented that ManufacturedItemDefinition.manufacturedDoseForm should also not be mandatory.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes final WG intent for making both dose-form elements optional.
